summary:
Independent terminal adjudication of four Automation findings. Accept W16 P1 (current signed Worker role revoked before pre-send) and W16 P2 (canonical project-generation guard lacks an isolated negative). Accept W23 P2 (combined standalone hosted fixture fails) and W23 P2 (reversed-clock check is masked by the idle threshold). The checkpoint evidence defines the bounded correction and proof for each.

Lease and routing: W16 original five new paths only (Client/AutomationNativeAccountProjectIngress.fs, existing leased files under tests/AutomationNativeAccountProjectIngress20261123/** and docs/testing/automation-native-account-project-ingress-20261123.md). W23 tests/AutomationHealthHosted20261123/** and docs/testing/automation-health-hosted-loopback-20261123.md only. All four corrections can be routed in the original tasks. No new task or source amendment is presently necessary. Lead must obtain a precise lease amendment first if later evidence identifies an essential out-of-lease path/callsite, with owner and reason. Keep production default OFF, terminal issuer/B2 and all activation/effect holds. No source, review or test edits, executions, main/push, deploy, provider, schedule, or cutover actions in adjudication.

Adjudicator 3, assigned attempt c46878d32fe54f2a92e07ea1e4fa3261, generation 1. Canonical v2 adjudication spec 59cd92c25cca27eda499aaf414f39ce3a46b7b8b. Independent of the authors, reviewers and correction proposers. Compared original specs, canonical review documents, and source in clean worktrees at both exact reviewed heads. Inbox had zero pending notifications. Evidence is read-only. Existing job records are identified below.
nextAction: Lead routes the accepted bounded fixes through the original W16 and W23 assignments and leases, then obtains fresh independent reviews of the exact corrected sources.
evidence:
W16 P1 — ACCEPT. Review 6055c83c9dd64ab09ef12c4b0dc249dd decision 12273, summary.md 0083fa59aac558fec41dc39be1ce6e17467cf6ac. Source 931b7dc93abb76fb3c5fc2f80208b974466e597e, accepted parent d312f1cc83685e781ce69e57ad0d4bf613bfb843, v2 spec 215087bdd0d7596f2859a1b69641aa04877d23fb items 1/3. NativeSchedulerRosterPolicy.fs 110–137 permits signed zero limits with the same membership. Tests.fs 110–155 signs both account and project limits, and 323–342 signs v2 with Worker zero but submits the v1-head claim. NativeSchedulerAccountReservation.fs 195–213 and 403–407 authenticate the roster at the current account head and discard the typed policy on the occupancy read. AccountCapacityLedger.fs 591–593 reads historical receipts at the current head. AutomationNativeAccountProjectIngress.fs 125–158 matches the persisted reservation and historical NativeReserve receipt, and 222–245 repeats that check before producing the project write. With current account head, refreshed coverage and a still-Started project, the new signed zero-capacity policy can pass those checks and allow HeldBeforeSend. This is established from source control flow. The current-head case was not executed by the reviewer or adjudicator. Impact is a disposable B1 fence admitted after Worker authorization has already been withdrawn. Public ingress is disabled and no provider effect is demonstrated.
Minimum repair in the new ingress module: reuse AccountCapacityLedger.readVerifiedDisposableNativeRosterPolicy (1346–1372), which returns the typed signed policy with verified account and project heads. Bind the projection to the exact claim/snapshot/coverage head(s) and candidate project identity/ledger/epoch, and require positive Worker policy at both account and member project in the existing repeated reservation validation before CAS. Keep the existing occupancy and original receipt checks. Zero denies this role. A positive pool already filled by this reservation is valid, so do not reuse the new-reservation spare-slot comparison or release occupancy. Do not add revocation epochs, locks, a production capability, or a cross-ledger atomicity claim. Those ledgers are verified individually. A revocation observed at the final account read must deny, and a move after the final account check can still race with a separate project CAS. RED/GREEN: same candidate, original reservation operation/record/receipt and project head, signed successor with zero Worker limit and unchanged membership, then claim the verified current account head with fresh coverage. Confirm the signed projection and original receipt still match, and require role-policy denial with no project HEAD, claim receipt or fence write and no account release. Retain positive coverage where one valid reservation fills a limit of one. Existing typed API suffices within the lease.

W16 P2 — ACCEPT. Same source, review, summary blob and spec v2 items 1/3. Tests.fs 291–311 changes the submitted candidate for role, generation, source and lease cases. Account record equality at AutomationNativeAccountProjectIngress.fs 143–152 can deny those before the project guard. The canonical task/attempt lease and generation check exists at 175–190. This is missing evidence for rejecting a stale project authorization while the account still recognizes the original candidate. It does not establish a source defect.
Minimum repair in the existing fixture tests: reserve the real signed disposable candidate, then move the canonical project attempt generation in disposable Git using the existing fixture transaction seam (Tests.fs 173–201), keeping the attempt Started and identity, role and source coherent. Refresh project head/coverage while preserving the signed account head/record/receipt, submitted candidate and UUIDs. Require the canonical Started assignment/source lease denial, current project HEAD unchanged after that claim, no claim receipt/fence and unchanged reservation. A project-only source rebind can use the same setup if proving the source mismatch separately. A rewritten attempt also changes its lease hash. This is proof of the compound project guard, not independent sensitivity of every comparator. Use a focused guard-bypass control if needed for RED-first evidence. No ingress logic change is justified by this finding.

W23 P2 — ACCEPT. Review 6dc6477b03ea47e4a202c4926e50f28a decision 12309, summary.md 3252a5e3fc0ba2ac83e88a7edbb0d706eee63fb9 and findings/hosted-suite-ingress-fails-in-combination.md 9cf5cb9a922c3661fbebb4038c908d7566fe7a8b. Source 2cb0af39012e416946cd32a1de033748d7bc4e56. Spec e5c8d455b90d5eb58ea5f22971f669cdce7bb989 RED-first items 2–5. Read terminal jobs directly: worker 0dd38e03d7d04291979bc034c21a4625 passed 2/2, reviewer combined 1ddcd8da30cc454c95b27ed310e40516 and ec3aa46f7cf84182b69302e4fbb52242 each exited 1 (1/2), and same-binary matrix-only dee299c6332948068a1c00ef5f5182ea passed 1/1. HostedNegativeTests.fs 104–117/145–166 checks HTTP status and a weak body substring, then reissues ingress on proof retries. ClientService.fs 242–285 queues qualifying activity before device selection. OptionalFeedbackStore.fs 105–168 synchronously invalidates confirmation for a newer same-key call and requires confirmed current-process proof. The failure proves a loss of required hosted proof before matrix assertions in combined runs. It does not establish cross-test shared store state, runner order, registration failure, or a SQLite defect. Repeated writes can also invalidate a pending proof, but the observed root cause is unconfirmed.
Minimum repair within standalone fixture/tests/docs: use combined runs as RED, make ingress proof gating and fixture isolation deterministic at the failing seam. Verify the actual authenticated MCP tool response and registered client identity, then poll verified Hub proof after one qualifying dispatch where supported, so polling does not itself invalidate pending proof. Inspect host/DB lifetimes, diagnostics and any shared process state before adding isolation. Use the smallest isolation supported by evidence, with bounded teardown, and avoid hiding failure with longer delays or separately filtered greens. GREEN requires complete standalone .NET 11 Release two-test 2/2 and a same-binary unfiltered confirmation with zero skips, actual /mcp and registered SignalR SQLite proof, existing two-client Git CAS, matrix assertions reached, retained negative control, and exact source/job/TRX evidence. No production seam change is supported by current evidence.

W23 P2 — ACCEPT. Same source/review/spec, findings/reversed-clock-guard-can-regress.md f89ff82331394f58fa592e65e84339d2e89f3b3a, matrix item 4 and earlier decision 12222. HostedNegativeTests.fs 189–206 projects +600s then +599s. NativeHealth.fs 76–86 and 124–152 still HOLD at the second idle check if only the monotonic comparison is deleted. Two reads, no Recover call and stable Git HEAD are then identical. This is source-proven masking of a test, with the guard present and no executed clock mutant claimed.
Minimum repair in HostedNegativeTests.fs: use two verified registered Hub reads for the same valid real LastSeen, stable canonical candidate and projected +601s then +600s. Both are idle under the inclusive 600s timeout. Require two reads, no errors, one HOLD, no recovery invocation and unchanged head. A paired monotonic control on the same setup with both observations eligible must reach the recovery spy and deterministic operation ID, exposing any other HOLD. Demonstrate sensitivity to bypassing only the clock comparison via an allowed test-only control if available. Keep the exact threshold case and independent foreign-project mutant. The retained-row rebuilt-host/DI denial covers in-process reset. Separate OS-process restart and successful post-restart requalification remain outside the observed evidence.
